column4: Beginner/non-expert Demon effectively has only two usable routes: Drunk is not a natural self-claim, has zero strategic support in this evidence, and can be especially implausible when Outsider count does not support it.
All three bluffs have full strategic support in this evidence and provide distinct beginner-usable information, recurring-action, and passive-survival claim routes.
All three bluffs are strategically supported and provide distinct beginner-usable information, passive-survival, and social-Outsider claim routes.

In a 6-player game, truthful Empath 0 gives excessive seat confirmation for the BEGINNER target even though current strategic-topology diagnostics remain neutral. Player-count matters: this may be acceptable at larger counts, but small games should prefer a misleading coherent trajectory. Multi-night Empath misinformation should be planned as a temporally coherent narrative, not as independent nightly values.
